review.notes: Main7e3dc151 attempt2 records 30/31 passed, one case21 action timeout: one successful coordinate gesture leaves the original system camera dialog visible. Attempt1 screenshot transport failure is separate, not replayed as this cause. Product sources/permissions/CI matrix remain unchanged. Limit to owned QA emulator, system controller packages, exact camera prompt, never Allow/settings. Replace fixed sleep/raw coordinates with fresh enabled native elements, at most two explicit denial clicks and an unchanged ten-second action deadline. No implicit retry of the whole case or swallowing driver errors. Keep original App denial alert/30s oracle and add read-only granted=false native-package assertion. Source-registered callback runs under fault-injection, not just a toy helper. Fake-clock component results are not real device acceptance; complete cloud phone/tablet journeys remain required.
